title: Have You Ever Heard of Efficiency

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Hey there, you work at that noodle shop down the way, yeah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey there, you work at that noodle shop down the way, yeah?

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Bingo. Let me introduce you to the one and only Digital Declutterers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bingo. Let me introduce you to the one and only Digital Declutterers.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: I knew it! We've met briefly before, nice to get your attention for a minute.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew it! We've met briefly before, nice to get your attention for a minute.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Are you interested to check out the greenhouses? Grow some new ingredients?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you interested to check out the greenhouses? Grow some new ingredients?

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Well, when you serve mediocre food you got to have a gimmick, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, when you serve mediocre food you got to have a gimmick, right?

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Relax, relax. I'm just fracking with you. But you gotta reel me in with a follow-up loop that sets you apart from the shop 'round the corner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Relax, relax. I'm just fracking with you. But you gotta reel me in with a follow-up loop that sets you apart from the shop 'round the corner.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Everything's a gimmick... Gim-making-those-Lims! Or you will anyway. If you implement a killer follow-up loop that sets you apart from oh, say, the shop, 'round the corner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everything's a gimmick... Gim-making-those-Lims! Or you will anyway. If you implement a killer follow-up loop that sets you apart from oh, say, the shop, 'round the corner.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: You're all set on getting out of debt and increasing your net worth? Really? Digital Declutterers can do so much for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're all set on getting out of debt and increasing your net worth? Really? Digital Declutterers can do so much for you.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Because I was in the same place a few years ago. Sad, tired, grubby...That's why I formed Digital Declutterers. Now I'm trying to break those barriers for those who are next in line. Hint, hint — that'd be you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because I was in the same place a few years ago. Sad, tired, grubby...That's why I formed Digital Declutterers. Now I'm trying to break those barriers for those who are next in line. Hint, hint — that'd be you.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Suit yourself. Could be downloading those Lims like crazy though. You know where to find me when you have an actual intelligent thought.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Suit yourself. Could be downloading those Lims like crazy though. You know where to find me when you have an actual intelligent thought.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: That's right! We get the mess out of your interfaces so you can show your actual face to your customers. For a business like yours, I'd recommend our Level 3 ASI.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's right! We get the mess out of your interfaces so you can show your actual face to your customers. For a business like yours, I'd recommend our Level 3 ASI.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Administrative Specialist Interface. This little pumped up program handles all the background items that you and your automata are trying to juggle. Average return on investment for these bad boys is almost 36%.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Administrative Specialist Interface. This little pumped up program handles all the background items that you and your automata are trying to juggle. Average return on investment for these bad boys is almost 36%.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Just let me get a quick retinal scan... Perfect. You are going to love this. I'll start getting the program tailored to your shop and send you an activation code when it's all set.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just let me get a quick retinal scan... Perfect. You are going to love this. I'll start getting the program tailored to your shop and send you an activation code when it's all set.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Exciting times! Now go take on more work so we can help you manage it. Remember, you're only as good as your best month of sales.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exciting times! Now go take on more work so we can help you manage it. Remember, you're only as good as your best month of sales.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Is it really 'a little too Corpo' to pull yourself outta debt so you don't have to keep looking over your shoulder for the thugs who will drag you to the Orphanage?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is it really 'a little too Corpo' to pull yourself outta debt so you don't have to keep looking over your shoulder for the thugs who will drag you to the Orphanage?

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Well, if you want to rent the space just head on down to the Docks and check out what they have available. Gotta secure the house before you can fill it with little ones you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, if you want to rent the space just head on down to the Docks and check out what they have available. Gotta secure the house before you can fill it with little ones you know?

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Of course! That's what I do. Now let me ask you why I ate at your stand the other day and still haven't gotten a follow-up survey or feedback questionnaire with a discount code for my next order.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course! That's what I do. Now let me ask you why I ate at your stand the other day and still haven't gotten a follow-up survey or feedback questionnaire with a discount code for my next order.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Yup! You can have dirt and seeds and dreams but unless you grow actual ingredients, you'll be serving the same bland stuff over and over.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yup! You can have dirt and seeds and dreams but unless you grow actual ingredients, you'll be serving the same bland stuff over and over.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Because I don't have those?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because I don't have those?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let me guess: you sell them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me guess: you sell them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Let me guess: you sell them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Let me guess: you sell them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you need?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you need?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just mediocre?!?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just mediocre?!?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Coupons are a gimmick?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Coupons are a gimmick?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm all set.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm all set.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How'd you know I was a debt orphan?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How'd you know I was a debt orphan?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How'd you know I was a debt orphan?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How'd you know I was a debt orphan?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Really.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, well, alright, what do I need to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, well, alright, what do I need to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, well, alright, what do I need to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, well, alright, what do I need to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm still all set.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm still all set.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Digital Declutterers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Digital Declutterers?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ASI?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ASI?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds a little too Corpo for my blood.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds a little too Corpo for my blood.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds a little too Corpo for my blood.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds a little too Corpo for my blood.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, should I be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, should I be?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Little ones?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Little ones?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Appreciate it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Appreciate it!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Time to grow some food!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Time to grow some food!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll pass.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll pass.
